title: P1: consciousness is a system’s experience of its own information

statements.text: Consciousness is the information system’s experience of its own information state and processing. Like inertial mass or charge, this is introduced as a fundamental property: experience is a fundamental feature of information, and so of the physics that supervenes on it.

sources.quote: P1: psychoinformational principle: Consciousness is the information-system’s experience of its own information state and processing.
Principle P1 asserts that experience is a fundamental feature of information, hence also of physics, which supervenes on it.
